label: sdc02_0340_bbteacher_02
text: Oh, thank goodness... What a relief...[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0340_bbteacher_03
text: I-I’m fine, thank you. Perfectly unharmed...[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0340_bbteacher_04
text: I let my obsession lead you all into a very\ndangerous situation...[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0340_bbteacher_05
text: It’s simply inexcusable. I’m so sorry, everyone...[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0340_sister_03
text: You’re completely fixated on this Terastal stuff!\nYou gotta keep your obsessiveness in check![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0340_brother_03
text: I wanted to be like h[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0202)]imer so, so badly.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0340_brother_04
text: I didn’t know what else to do...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0340_brother_05
text: But I guess I just don’t have it in me to be like\nh[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0202)]imer after all.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0340_brother_06
text: Finally... Finally I can let it go.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0340_sister_04
text: I swear! I’ve got such a silly younger brother...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0340_bbteacher_07
text: Oh, you two must’ve been so scared...[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0340_bbteacher_10
text: But you all shone brilliantly just now. You were\ntruly dazzling![VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0340_bbteacher_09
text: So I think we can consider our little expedition\ninto Area Zero good and finished.\c\nTime to head back to Blueberry Academy![VAR 0x0114(0042)]
